name: supo-codegym-hffetchprobe-h100
description: 1-GPU probe: in-pod HF snapshot_download rate for Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct (8 workers, progress every 60 s, 25 min cap)

job_template_config.entrypoint_full_script:
tar xzf /mnt/hdfs/mlsys/users/xiaoxuan/supo_codegym/job-assets/envs-supo.tar.gz -C / && PY=/home/tiger/xiaoxuan/envs/supo/bin/python && mkdir -p /tmp/models/m && timeout 1500 $PY -u - <<'PYEOF'
import time, threading, os
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
t0=time.time(); stop=False; last=0
def report():
    global last
    while not stop:
        sz=sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(r,f)) for r,_,fs in os.walk("/tmp/models/m") for f in fs)
        print(f"[fetch] {sz/1e9:.1f} GB after {time.time()-t0:.0f}s ({(sz-last)/60/1e6:.0f} MB/s last minute)", flush=True); last=sz; time.sleep(60)
threading.Thread(target=report, daemon=True).start()
snapshot_download("Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct", local_dir="/tmp/models/m", allow_patterns=["*.json","*.safetensors","*.txt","*.jinja","merges.txt","vocab.json"], max_workers=8)
stop=True; sz=sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(r,f)) for r,_,fs in os.walk("/tmp/models/m") for f in fs); print(f"[fetch] DONE {sz/1e9:.1f} GB in {time.time()-t0:.0f}s", flush=True)
PYEOF
echo "[fetch] exit=$?"; exit 0
